fix(runtime): fall back to a microtask when setImmediate cannot schedule finalizers (#244)

GC callbacks may run without an I/O context, e.g. FinalizationRegistry cleanup in workerd, where host timers throw. Previously enqueueFinalizer set finalizationScheduled and ref() before scheduling, so a throwing setImmediate left finalizers stuck and kept destroy() from draining the queue.

Keep setImmediate by default to match Node-API, fall back to queueMicrotask (or a resolved promise), and only mark the environment as scheduled after scheduling
